candidates.lead: SA nurse pay rates are set by the Nursing/Midwifery (South Australian Public Sector) Enterprise Agreement 2022, whose last printed column applies from 1 January 2025. On that scale a Registered Nurse/Midwife Level 1 earns $74,831 a year at the 1st increment and $102,103 at the 9th [[SA_NURSING_PAY]]; a 4% administrative increase has applied since January 2026, with 2% more due in October 2026.

A registered nurse's salary in South Australia on SA Health's public sector scale runs from $74,831 a year at the first increment to $102,103 at the ninth [[SA_NURSING_PAY]], as printed in the Nursing/Midwifery (SA Public Sector) Enterprise Agreement 2022 from 1 January 2025. Those base figures exclude shift and weekend loadings; current pay is 4% higher after the January 2026 administrative increase.

SA Health pay scales for nurses and midwives come from the Nursing/Midwifery (South Australian Public Sector) Enterprise Agreement 2022, which nominally expired on 31 July 2025; a proposed 2026 replacement was rejected at ballot in July 2026. The published Registered Nurse Level 1 scale is $74,831 to $102,103 a year [[SA_NURSING_PAY]], plus a 4% administrative increase from January 2026.
